jobs.description:
fonio builds AI phone agents, plus WhatsApp, chat and email assistants, for small and medium-sized businesses. We have 10,000+ customers and grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months. We're now expanding across Europe, Brazil and the US.

We work with ownership, direct feedback, few meetings and no politics. You run your area like it's your company. 1 Sales Enablement Manager (m/f/d) The role

We ship new features every week, and our sales team is growing across several markets. As Sales Enablement Manager, you make sure every seller knows what they're selling, who to sell it to and how to win the deal.

You'll train, coach and run role plays, and you'll connect Product and Sales. Your goal is to get new AEs to target faster and help the whole team win more, and bigger, deals.

What you'll do

 * Run weekly sales enablement sessions, including role plays, deal reviews and live practice.

 * Capture what our best AEs do differently and turn it into repeatable playbooks for the team.

 * Own AE onboarding and make it faster, so new hires reach their targets sooner.

 * Keep sales up to date on every product release. Explain what changed, who it's for and how to pitch it.

 * Create the material sellers actually use: pitch decks, talk tracks, objection handling and battlecards.

 * Act as the link between Product and Sales. Bring product updates to the team and bring field feedback back to Product.

 * Coach AEs one-to-one on calls and deals.

 * Track and improve the numbers: ramp time for new AEs, win rate and average contract value.

What you bring

 * You have experience in sales enablement, sales training or a similar role at a B2B SaaS company.

 * You have a sales background, ideally as an AE, so sellers respect what you teach.

 * You know sales methodology well and can turn it into practical, hands-on training.

 * You're comfortable leading a room and getting people to practise, not just listen.

 * You can take a complex product update and explain it clearly in minutes.

 * You're analytical and use data to see what's working and what isn't.

 * You're fluent in English. Spanish or other European languages are a plus.

Nice to have

 * Experience in a fast-shipping product environment, where the pitch changes every week.

 * Experience selling to SMBs or in a high-velocity sales environment.

 * Experience building an onboarding program from scratch.

What you get

 * High visibility. Your work shows up directly in revenue.

 * Close work with the CCO, the sales team and Product.

 * A team of ambitious people, many of them former founders.

 * Salary: €80000 - €110000.

Process

 * Intro Call (30 mins)

 * Skill Interview (60 mins)

 * Interview with CCO (30 mins)

 * Culture Call (20 mins)

fonio is an equal opportunity employer. If you meet most of this and want to help a fast-growing sales team win, apply.

Founded in 2020 to solve the biggest challenges in the energy industry, enspired has been pushing the boundaries of innovation since day one. Driven by the belief that technology will make the energy transition a reality, we developed a state-of-the-art optimization platform in the early days of algo trading to integrate the flexibility we need for an efficient and sustainable energy system.

Today we know that future-proof battery revenues are the backbone of the renewable buildout. As the leader of the transparency movement in BESS revenue assessment, we publish verifiable commercial results to establish a new, reliable benchmarking standard that helps battery owners get a true understanding of what their asset is worth. 1 Senior Sales Expert (f/m/x) Join us and help drive the energy transition

Have you always wanted to be part of a team that makes a difference? As the leading optimizer of Grid Scale Storage across Europe, we do just that! We are expanding our team and looking for a Senior Sales Expert (f/m/x) who wants to play a key role in strengthening our position across Europe. As part of our Growth Team, you will enjoy strong go-to-market support from both marketing and business development.

Note: We can consider candidates based in Austria, Belgium, Slovakia, Spain, and the UK

Ready to make a difference? As part of our handpicked growth team, you will

 * Build relationships with renewable and grid-scale storage developers in your region

 * Take full responsibility for the entire B2B sales cycle

 * Manage opportunities, your pipeline, and close deals

 * Work with your colleagues to provide value at every stage of a client's project

 * Share our vision at every touchpoint - calls/events/initiatives

 * Ultimately, win and retain satisfied customers

Job requirements

How you fit into the team

You want to participate in the transition to clean energy actively, and

 * Bring +5 years of quota-carrying sales experience

 * Have an understanding of the power industry and the role that flexibility plays in the energy transition

 * Have competence in complex and solution-oriented sales methods

 * Are enthusiastic when articulating technical and business value

 * Enjoy developing and executing a comprehensive territory plan

 * Are eager to leverage marketing automation strategies

 * Bring perfect oral and written communication in English as well as in Polish or Italian

 * Have been actively involved in the Polish or Italian markets (nice to have)

 * Like to travel and to drive the sales cycle even on business trips

 * Value excellent team spirit and creative freedom

What's in it for you?

We believe in transparency and keep our colleagues updated on every aspect of our business. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of benefits

 * Hybrid and flexible working model

 * 30 days of vacation

 * 60 days of work from anywhere

 * Referral bonus

 * Extensive support of lifelong learners

 * Regular social events and holiday parties in Austria

 * Free lunch & fruits and fair-trade coffee at the office

 * Offsetting your private CO2 emissions

 * Sustainable enspired merch

 * Very competitive compensation package with uncapped commission

 * Continuous sales and industry training

We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants. We offer an attractive salary which corresponds to your skills of at least EUR 85.000 gross per year.

Our AI handles every call automatically. But voice is just the beginning. Our vision: to build the world's first fully automated CRM.

We live ownership. You're responsible for your projects and tasks end-to-end. No politics, few meetings, direct feedback. At fonio you'll build alongside the smartest and most ambitious people around.

Join us now to be part of one of Europe's most exciting growth stories! 1 Junior Customer Success Manager (DACH) (m/f/d) Your Role

As Junior Customer Success Manager for Activation in DACH, you make sure every new German-speaking customer goes from "just signed" to "fonio picks up our calls every day". You own the first weeks of the customer journey: setting up their AI assistant, testing and fine-tuning it, and getting it live on their phone line.

You'll spend most of your time in onboarding calls with customers and inside the fonio platform. You learn how every feature works and figure out the best setup for each customer, whether that's a dental practice in Munich, a law firm in Vienna or a car workshop in Zurich.

 

What to expect

 * Run onboarding calls with new DACH customers and set up their AI assistant together with them

 * Translate each customer's business into a working setup: prompt, knowledge base, call transfers, notifications and integrations

 * Test and fine-tune assistants until they're ready to go live, so customers don't get stuck in "almost done"

 * Help customers connect their phone system and get call forwarding running

 * Follow up with customers who signed but aren't active yet, and get them over the line

 * Become a power user of the platform: learn how each feature works and which setup fits which use case

 * Bring patterns and friction points from onboardings back to Product and CS to improve templates, guides and the product

 * Hand activated customers over to Customer Success with a clean setup and clear notes

 * Track your onboardings and activation results in HubSpot

 

Who We're Looking For

 * 0-2 years of experience in a customer-facing role (onboarding, support, CS, sales, hospitality or customer service) or a strong graduate profile. Internships count.

 * German, fluent English

 * Basic technical skills and real curiosity about how things work. You enjoy clicking through a platform until you understand it, and you're not scared of webhooks, APIs or phone settings.

 * You like solving puzzles: "How do I build this for this customer?" excites you

 * You explain things simply and stay patient with non-technical customers, by phone or video

 * Structured: you can run several onboardings in parallel without dropping anything

 * Hands-on and quick to learn. You take initiative and don't wait to be told what to do.

 * Willing to relocate to Vienna

What We Offer

 * €50,000-55,000

 * You'll learn AI and voice tech faster than anywhere else, with a real path into Customer Success, Solutions or Forward Deployment

 * Lunch and dinner are on us. Every day.

 * The fridge is always full: Red Bull, Mate, Cola, Almdudler and more

 * Need a tool, course or book? It's yours. No approval loops.

 * Your setup, your choice: pick the gear you want to work with

 * A product customers actually love: 4.5 stars on Trustpilot, Google and OMR. It mostly sells itself.

 * Onsite in Vienna with a team that's here to do the best work of their careers

 

Hiring Process

 * 20 min intro call

 * 30 min skill interview

 * 15 min with interview with our CCO

 * 20 min culture call with our Founders

Working with us means believing in the future; in the great people who are shaping it together every day and in the wide-ranging career paths it opens up. #believeinyourselfErste Group was founded in 1819 as the first Austrian savings bank and today it is one of the largest banking groups in Central and Eastern Europe (CEE). As an attractive employer, Erste Group offers interesting career opportunities in an international environment.

At Erste Group, we are committed to shaping the future of banking through the responsible and innovative use of AI. Our AI Office is a growing, agile team, driving AI strategy, governance, and enablement. As we expand, we're looking for a new team member who combines strategic thinking, operational execution, and a hands-on mindset for shaping AI in a regulated environment. 1 AI Governance Advisor (all genders)  * Location:Wien

 * Working hours:Full-time

 * Occupational Area:Consulting / Projekt Management, IT

 * Company:Erste Group Bank AG

Your Tasks

As AI Governance Advisor, you will be at the intersection of AI governance, technology, and innovation. Your work will span three key areas:

AI Governance & Compliance

 * Support the implementation and evolution of the Group AI Governance Framework.

 * Contribute to assessments under the EU AI Act and internal risk frameworks.

 * Interface with Legal, Compliance, Security, and Data teams.

AI Strategy & Innovation

 * Support the Group AI Officer in developing and evolving the AI strategy across Erste entities.

 * Engage with key stakeholders to identify emerging AI trends and their relevance to the bank.

 * Help translate strategic ambitions into actionable programs.

Operational Enablement & Use Case Support

 * Act as a sparring partner for AI use case owners across Erste Group.

 * Closely collaborate with other units dealing with AI in Erste Digital.

 * Coordinate the onboarding of new AI systems, including risk assessments and architectural alignment.

 * Contribute to cross-functional working groups, task forces, and pilots.

Your Background

 * Several years of professional experience, ideally in a top-tier consultancy, technology advisory, or in-house transformation role.

 * Strong project or program management skills (PMP, Prince2, or agile certifications a plus).

 * A solid understanding of IT or data governance; experience in regulated industries is an asset.

 * Keen interest in AI technologies, digital innovation, and their real-world applications.

 * Excellent communication skills in English; German is a plus.

 * A collaborative mindset and ability to bridge business, tech, and compliance perspectives.

Our Offer

 * A high-impact role in a strategic function.

 * Close collaboration with senior leadership and cross-border teams.

 * A modern and flexible working environment in the heart of Vienna.

 * Opportunities to shape the bank's responsible AI journey and grow into a leadership role.

 * Discover and enjoy the benefits of Erste Group
